entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So Kamoshida's had a change[n]of heart now, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't really care what[n]happens to him...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But it'd totally leave a bad[n]taste in my mouth if he wound[n]up dead or something.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey! Don't say stuff like that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We didn't kill his Shadow,[n]so he should be fine, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I never thought I'd end[n]up worrying about a[n]bastard like him.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm sure we'll find something[n]out when tomorrow rolls around.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I'm looking forward to it!
